fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description:
Detects usage of SoftPerfect's "netscan.exe". An application for scanning networks.
It is actively used in-the-wild by threat actors to inspect and understand the network architecture of a victim.
fields.name: PUA - SoftPerfect Netscan Execution
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (tgt.process.image.path contains "\\netscan.exe" or tgt.process.displayName="Network Scanner" or tgt.process.displayName="Application for scanning networks"))
